scores.claim_text: IonQ's quantum computing solution is currently delivered via AWS Amazon Braket, Microsoft Azure Quantum, and Google Cloud Marketplace.
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext for 'IonQ' restricted to AMZN/MSFT/GOOGL CIKs; also product-name 'Forte' restricted to AMZN
scores.M_value: AMZN: 2 stale 8-K hits from 2020 (both pre-deSPAC press releases). MSFT: 0 hits. GOOGL: 0 hits. AMZN/'Forte': 0 hits. General 'IonQ Forte' search returns 38 hits, all IonQ's own filings.
scores.interpretation: Hyperscaler distribution is technically real (Braket/Azure/GCP do list IonQ in marketing pages) but none of the three $1T+ hyperscalers consider IonQ material enough to mention in any SEC filing post-2020. Per Heuristic 7, this is the 'available via partner ecosystem' pre-deployment pattern: the channel exists but the revenue scale is small for hyperscalers. Score MODERATE rather than RED because IonQ does not claim headline revenue from the hyperscalers, only distribution access.

scores.claim_text: IonQ acquired Oxford Ionics Limited in September 2025 for approximately $1.6B; $422.9M allocated to developed-technology intangibles.
scores.M_value: 20 hits including IonQ's own 8-Ks dated 2025-06-09 (announcement), 2025-09-17 (closing 8-K + ex99 PR), 2025-09-18 (8-K/A with audited financials), confirming the acquisition closed on the date claimed in the 10-K. Critical Audit Matter in EY's audit opinion specifically discusses Oxford Ionics valuation, providing third-party audit corroboration.
scores.interpretation: Acquisition is fully corroborated. However note: $1.6B paid for a UK trapped-ion startup with no commercial revenue is a large bet, and ~26% of consideration ($422.9M of $1.6B) was capitalized as intangible 'developed technology' — the EY Critical Audit Matter flags the inherent estimation uncertainty in the valuation. This is a fact-check PASS for the acquisition existence but reasonably triggers Heuristic 4 (strategic / amplification) on integration risk going forward.

scores.claim_text: IonQ entered into a $1.8B definitive agreement to acquire SkyWater Technology, a US semiconductor foundry, on January 25, 2026.
scores.M_check: Disclosed in 10-K Subsequent Events Note 22 with specific cash/stock collar terms; SkyWater is itself a public SEC filer so transaction is auditable
scores.M_value: 10-K Subsequent Events discloses $15.00 cash + $20.00 IonQ stock per SkyWater share with explicit volume-weighted-average collar ($37.99-$60.13), $1.0B cash use, expected to close within 12 months subject to SkyWater shareholder and regulatory approval. Per Heuristic 10, the transaction is a large 'balance-sheet-pivot acquisition' (~30% of $3.34B cash + $0.8B in stock); a quantum pure-play acquiring a semiconductor foundry is a category change worth flagging.
scores.interpretation: Acquisition agreement existence is PASS (well-disclosed with specific terms). The $1.0B cash deployment plus pending closing risk is a real overhang but the claim itself ('we entered into a definitive agreement') is verifiable.

scores.claim_text: IonQ reported GAAP revenue of $130.0M for FY2025, up from $43.1M in FY2024 (~3.0x).
scores.M_value: Only one direct IonQ federal prime-contract award returned: AFRL FA875022C1022 'TRAPPED ION QUANTUM COMPUTER', $13.4M total obligation. Other rows in the USAspending result are unrelated entities (DecisionQ Information Operations, DecisionQuest LLC) caught by substring matching. FY25 reported revenue $130M would require either substantial commercial revenue, federal sub-contract / grant flows not captured in this prime-contract search, or revenue from acquired entities (Capella SAR imagery from July 2025, Oxford Ionics, id Quantique QKD) added mid-year.
scores.interpretation: GAAP revenue jumped 3x to $130M while only $13M shows in direct federal prime-contract awards. A material share of the FY25 revenue jump is plausibly driven by the 2025 acquisitions rather than organic trapped-ion quantum-computer revenue. Per Heuristics 11 and 4 (acquisitive growth obscures organic quantum-compute traction). Score MODERATE — revenue is GAAP-audited so it is real, but composition merits scrutiny and the organic trapped-ion compute revenue is likely far below $130M.

scores.claim_text: IonQ acquired id Quantique SA (QKD), Vector Atomic (sensing), Capella Space (SAR satellites), Lightsynq (photonic interconnect) in 2025 and Skyloom (optical comms) in January 2026.
scores.M_value: id Quantique: 43 hits including SK Telecom 20-Fs (SKM was prior owner of IDQ) confirming entity existence; IonQ own 8-Ks and 10-K Exhibit 21 confirm consolidation. Capella Space: corroborated via IonQ 8-Ks and EY Critical Audit Matter audit of Capella developed-technology fair value ($82.9M). $424.8M purchase consideration disclosed.
scores.interpretation: Acquisitions are real and well-disclosed (PASS on fact-check). Separately, this is fundamentally a basket-of-bolt-ons strategy: IonQ has pivoted from pure trapped-ion quantum-computer pure-play into a 'quantum platform' holding company spanning QKD (IDQ), quantum sensing (Vector Atomic), SAR satellites (Capella), photonic interconnect (Lightsynq), optical comms (Skyloom), and pending semiconductor foundry (SkyWater). This category drift is a watch-item: when a quantum-compute pure-play uses a $3.3B war chest to acquire across unrelated adjacencies, it can indicate organic trapped-ion compute commercialization is not generating sufficient growth on its own.

scores.claim_text: Net loss attributable to IonQ was $510.4M in 2025 (vs $331.6M in 2024 and $157.8M in 2023); accumulated deficit $1,194.1M as of Dec 31, 2025; net cash used in operations $283.2M in 2025.
scores.M_check: Self-disclosure audited by EY with unqualified opinion (Feb 25, 2026)
scores.M_value: Loss trajectory accelerating: 2023 -$157.8M, 2024 -$331.6M (+110%), 2025 -$510.4M (+54%). Operating cash burn 2023 -$78.8M, 2024 -$105.7M, 2025 -$283.2M (+168% YoY). FY25 loss to revenue ratio: $510M / $130M = 3.9x. EY's unqualified audit opinion and no going-concern modification ($3.34B cash provides clear 12-month runway).
scores.interpretation: Losses are real and audited (no contradiction, hence supports=true). MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY because: (a) loss-to-revenue ratio of 3.9x is consistent with pre-commercialization research stage despite the 'we sell to customers' framing in Item 1, (b) operating cash burn nearly tripled YoY in 2025 even with the acquisition revenue inflows, (c) per Heuristic 3 (planned vs operational), the gap between IonQ's marketing language ('world's only quantum platform company, leading quantum computing company') and the financial reality (a $510M-loss research-stage company) is wide. The financing-driven cash position masks the deteriorating operating economics.

scores.claim_text: IonQ raised approximately $3.36B in financing in 2025 via Series A and Series B private warrants ($99.88 and $155.00 strike), leaving cash and investments of $3,336.8M.
scores.M_check: Self-disclosure in Notes 12-13 with specific warrant counts and strikes; cash flow statement shows $3,358.6M financing inflow
scores.M_value: FY25 financing inflow $3,358.6M vs FY24 $41.7M and FY23 $1.8M — a 80x step-up. Series A (July 2025): 3.86M prefunded + 36.04M private warrants at $99.88. Series B (Oct 2025): 5.0M prefunded + 43.01M private warrants at $155.00. All prefunded warrants exercised by Dec 31, 2025 (consistent with same-day exercise mechanic). Warrant liabilities at Dec 31, 2025: $2.47B (Level 3 fair-value remeasurement risk going forward).
scores.interpretation: Capital raise is real and clearly disclosed (PASS). Two analytical notes for downstream evaluation: (1) the $2.47B warrant liability is mark-to-market through the income statement and will swing P&L meaningfully with IonQ's stock price, creating large non-cash gains/losses each quarter; (2) the FY25 warrant raises at $99.88-$155.00 strikes only complete in-the-money if IonQ trades above those levels, so the dilutive impact and warrant-liability volatility depend on share-price evolution post-cutoff.

scores.claim_text: IonQ has an 'extensive patent portfolio' in quantum technology.
scores.M_value: 122 granted patents pre-cutoff (373 total applications). Patent titles directly in claimed technology: photonic integrated circuit for multi-atom arrays, trapped-ion gates, quantum-enhanced topological data analysis, quantum chemistry circuit optimization, diamond color centers for quantum devices, swapping quantum information between mixed-species ion pairs. Strong match to claimed trapped-ion / quantum-compute area.
scores.interpretation: Comfortably exceeds Heuristic 8 threshold (n_granted >= 10 with claimed-area hits). Patent portfolio claim is fully corroborated and substantive — not the Nikola pattern of unrelated patents.
